definitions.gloss: nap; short sleep; catnap; brief rest
definitions.explanation: a short period of sleep, typically taken during the day to restore energy

examples.japanese: {昼休|ひるやす}みに{仮眠|かみん}を{取|と}った。
examples.english: I took a nap during lunch break.

examples.japanese: {長時間|ちょうじかん}の{運転|うんてん}の{前|まえ}に{仮眠|かみん}を{取|と}る{方|ほう}がいい。
examples.english: You should take a nap before a long drive.

examples.japanese: {会社|かいしゃ}に{仮眠室|かみんしつ}があるので、{疲|つか}れた{時|とき}に{休|やす}める。
examples.english: There's a nap room at the company, so I can rest when I'm tired.

notes:
FORMATION:
{仮|かり} (temporary) + {眠|みん} (sleep) → temporary sleep

VERB FORM:
{仮眠|かみん}する (to take a nap)
{仮眠|かみん}を{取|と}る (to take a nap)

RELATED FACILITIES:
- {仮眠室|かみんしつ} (nap room)
- {仮眠|かみん}スペース (nap space)

DIFFERENCE FROM OTHER SLEEP WORDS:
- {昼寝|ひるね} (afternoon nap) - casual, usually at home
- {仮眠|かみん} (nap) - more formal, can be at work
- うたた{寝|ね} (dozing off) - unintentional, light sleep
- {居眠|いねむ}り (nodding off) - falling asleep while sitting

WORKPLACE CONTEXT:
Many Japanese companies now recognize the benefits of napping and provide {仮眠室|かみんしつ} (nap rooms) for employees. Power naps of 15-20 minutes are recommended for productivity.
